meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把原始数据套用「Setup-Conflict-Resolution」叙事框架,生成结合图表与业务背景的洞察报告,产出面向非技术受众的结论与行动建议。
howto.when: 当你向高管汇报、做季度业务回顾或投资者演示等场合,需要把数据讲成故事时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude turns raw data into narratives using the Setup-Conflict-Resolution framework, producing insight reports with visuals and business context for non-technical audiences.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you present analytics to executives, prepare quarterly business reviews or investor decks, or communicate data insights to non-technical audiences.

say_en.note: Produces a report with hook, insight, recommendations
